name: zvideo_set_fog_color_from_rgb01
description: zVideo::SetFogColorFromRgb01 scales current fog RGB values into pending 255-space video globals.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo fog-color helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo/zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4a7220 shows three multiplies by 255.0f from the input RGB floats into g_zVideo_FogColorPendingR255/G255/B255.
The native smokes verify direct RGB 0..1 to 255-space writes and renderer/model fog callers that depend on the same pending globals.
